signal: same policy edited in many unrelated files
preferred_response: find existing owner and change once

signal: callers add null or retry guards around shared failure
preferred_response: patch shared boundary after tracing callers

signal: component decides persistence or authorization
preferred_response: move policy to domain/service owner

signal: callers construct SQL or response DTO
preferred_response: keep adapter contract and map at boundary

signal: caller behavior changes without type/schema update
preferred_response: make contract change explicit and test consumers

signal: internal object passed as wire/storage data
preferred_response: define serializer and compatibility cases

signal: new flags threaded through many layers
preferred_response: model explicit state only when combinations are real

signal: props/server data copied into local state
preferred_response: derive or name independent draft state

signal: promise started without owner or error path
risk: unhandled failure or stale side effect
preferred_response: await or explicitly own/cancel task

signal: await then UI/native context is used
preferred_response: guard lifecycle or cancel operation

signal: network retry repeats non-idempotent effect
preferred_response: add idempotency and bounded classified retry

signal: catch returns default without evidence
preferred_response: preserve cause and expose actionable state

signal: low layer invents UI message or high layer lacks context
preferred_response: handle where recovery context exists

signal: untrusted input reaches domain or DB
preferred_response: validate at trust boundary and preserve domain checks

signal: write path updates source but not related cache
preferred_response: define key/version/invalidation owner

signal: fix clears all cache after one mutation
preferred_response: repair affected key/version only

signal: concurrent requests update same state by completion order
preferred_response: sequence/cancel/version writes

signal: one slow task blocks all accounts/items
preferred_response: lock only shared invariant and document ceiling

signal: related writes commit in separate operations
preferred_response: keep invariant writes in one transaction

signal: flag has no owner or removal condition
preferred_response: record default owner and delete trigger

signal: project config changed without target build evidence
preferred_response: inspect generated/owned config then build affected target

signal: external data cast through any or non-null assertions
preferred_response: narrow unknown with validation

signal: new generic layer has one consumer
preferred_response: keep local until reuse or volatility boundary
